sources.title: Ministral 3 3B - docs.mistral.ai
sources.snippet: Ministral 3 3B is the smallest and most efficient model in the Ministral 3 family, offering robust language and vision capabilities in a compact package. Designed for edge deployment, it delivers high performance across diverse hardware, including local setups.

sources.title: ai-hub-models/src/qai_hub_models/models/ministral_3_3b ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: Ministral is a compact language model from Mistral AI designed for on-device deployment, offering strong instruction-following capabilities with low latency. This is based on the implementation of Ministral-3-3B-Instruct-2512 found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices.

sources.title: Ministral 3 - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Available in three sizes: 3B, 8B, and 14B parameters, all Ministral 3 models are descendants of Mistral Small 3.1 1, obtained via a Cascade Distillation approach. We present three variants for each model size: base, instruct, and reasoning, each with image understanding capabilities and context lengths up to 256k tokens (128k for reasoning models).
